name: Wenningstedt-Braderup (Germany)
description: Yellow field charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Wenningstedt-Braderup (a serpent on red above blue and white wavy stripes).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 11 May 1959; the flag shows the municipal arms in the middle of a yellow field, shifted slightly towards the staff.

features.role: Wenningstedt-Braderup arms — serpent above wavy stripes
